mapper.sql: SELECT d.id AS document_id, v.id AS version_id, d.space_id, d.status AS document_status, s.archived AS space_archived, v.version_no, cv.version_no AS current_version_no, d.current_version_id, v.uploader_user_id, v.publication_policy, v.publication_protocol, v.publication_evidence, v.state_version, v.index_status, v.indexed_profile_id, v.indexed_fingerprint, v.indexed_epoch, v.indexed_chunk_count, v.published_at FROM kb_document_version v JOIN kb_document d ON d.id = v.doc_id JOIN kb_space s ON s.id = d.space_id LEFT JOIN kb_document_version cv ON cv.id = d.current_version_id AND cv.doc_id = d.id WHERE d.id = #{documentId} AND v.id = #{versionId}
mapper.select: SELECT d.id AS document_id, v.id AS version_id, d.space_id, d.status AS document_status, s.archived AS space_archived, v.state_version, v.publication_policy, v.publication_protocol, v.publication_evidence, v.uploader_user_id, v.version_no, v.index_status FROM kb_document_version v JOIN kb_document d ON d.id = v.doc_id JOIN kb_space s ON s.id = d.space_id WHERE d.id = #{documentId} ORDER BY v.id FOR UPDATE OF d, v
